title: Extraction Protocol for Untargeted LC-MS/MS from Urine Samples
author: Mauricio Caraballo
materials: 2 mL Qiagen sample tubes (catalog no. 990381) Shallow polypropylene 96-well plate (Cat. No. 951040048) Deep polypropylene 96-well plate (Cat. No. 951033405) Seal plates (Cat. No. ZAFPE50) Note: for LC-MS/MS acquisition AlumaSeal CS (Sealing Foil, Excel Scientific) (Cat. No. FC100) Note: for long time storage

steps.title: Transfer urine to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 25–200 µL of urine (minimum 25 µL; for human samples typically 100–200 µL) into an empty sample tube.

steps.title: Add pre‑chilled extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add pre‑chilled extraction solvent (100 % methanol containing 1 µM sulfamethazine, Optima™ LC/MS‑grade, Fisher Catalog #A456‑4, CAS 67‑56‑1) at a 1:4 sample‑to‑solvent ratio to achieve a final concentration of 80 % MeOH. For a 200 µL urine sample add 800 µL solvent; for a 25 µL low‑volume sample add 100 µL solvent.

steps.title: Vortex mix
steps.instruction: Mix the sample by vortexing for 2 seconds (00:00:02).

steps.title: Protein precipitation at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tubes at –20 °C for 20 minutes (00:20:00) to aid protein precipitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 2000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00) to pellet the protein precipitate. Perform at 4 °C if possible.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified supernatant into a pre‑labeled 96‑well DeepWell plate: for normal volumes transfer 800 µL per well; for low‑volume samples (e.g., 25 µL urine with 100 µL solvent) transfer 100 µL per well. Store any remaining supernatant at –80 °C.

steps.title: Dry samples in CentriVap
steps.instruction: Dry the plates using a centrifugal low‑pressure system (CentriVap). Drying time may vary; check progress every 4 hours.

steps.title: Cover and store dried plates
steps.instruction: Cover the dried DeepWell plate with a compatible seal and store at –80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Re‑suspend in internal‑standard solution
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend each well with 250 µL of a 50 % methanol / water solution (v/v) containing 1 µM sulfadimethoxine (CAS 122‑11‑2) as an internal standard.
